comment: Guns dropped on death on Larak Lot's free-for-all (gameplay 59): rule bots frag each other and the newest dropped gun is framed where it fell, then again in its last seconds as it blinks. Run with FRAGR_QA_BOTS=6 and FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/dropped-guns.json.

states.name: dropped_gun
states.note: A fragged fighter's gun lies on the floor where they fell, seated with its contact shadow and no pad under it.

states.name: dropped_gun_wide
states.note: Readable from across a few bays: the same gun picture as a pad.
